notes.subject: fix(approvals): show reviewers full inline scripts, catch Git object-write denials
notes.summary: Approval cards and reviewers now see full bodies (up to 64 KB) of inline scripts run through interpreters, and sandbox-denied Git object writes in protected repositories get native retry guidance.

notes.subject: fix(openai-compatible): send image history without extra heap copies
notes.summary: Image-heavy sessions on OpenAI-compatible providers no longer exhaust memory, because request bodies are encoded into a single off-heap buffer with identical wire bytes.
